reason: A verification gate plugin that runs workspace tests or configured commands, records their results, and requires a fresh successful verification before work can be concluded.

summaries.zh: 在结案前运行工作区验证命令并记录结果，且在发生修改后要求重新验证的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that runs workspace verification commands, records their results, and requires fresh successful verification before work can be concluded.

capabilities: Runs configured or auto-detected workspace verification commands
Evaluates command success using process exit codes
Stores verification receipts and invalidates them after successful mutating tools
Prevents conclusion until verification is successful, current, and non-expired
